mechanism: On each new D1 bar, open a one-bar long only after N consecutive completed closes in the same direction (down or up vs open), or unconditionally for open-to-close bias; close at next bar open. Compare win rates to 50% across instruments to detect memory/non-random conditional probability shifts.
data_needed: OHLC series; consecutive-close count N∈{1,2,3}; direction enum; one-bar hold PnL; identical date window across symbols.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: XAUUSD, BTCUSD, GBPUSD, NAS100; D1; 2025-01-01 to 2025-11-30; fixed 0.1 lot.
why_new_for_mis: Turns prior-bar close sequences into an explicit conditional-probability sensor: weakness stacks (esp. 3 down closes) shift next-bar bullish odds asymmetrically vs strength stacks—MIS can track this bias by instrument without a trading overlay.
quote: In a random system, increasing the number of prior bearish candles should not increase bullish probability. Here, it does, especially in Gold and Bitcoin.

mechanism: Detect LW short-term low on bars 1–3: bar2 low < lows of bars 1 and 3; bar2 must not be outside vs bar3; bar1 must not be inside vs bar2; then measure next-bar bullish close frequency after the pattern.
data_needed: Three completed bars high/low; outside/inside exclusions; next-bar open→close outcome.
why_new_for_mis: Structural swing-low with outside/inside hygiene as a discrete reversal-readiness event—MIS can emit a structure-change flag when a clean short-term low completes.
quote: A well-defined short-term low changes the probability of the next candle.

mechanism: At new-bar open compute swingA=|high[4]−low[1]| and swingB=|high[2]−low[4]|; usableRange=max(swingA,swingB) as dominant recent expansion; project buy/sell breakouts as open±multiplier×range; confirm with M1 close crossover of those levels.
data_needed: Highs/lows at shifts 1,2,4; open/ask/bid; buy/sell/stop multipliers; M1 closes for cross detection.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: XAUUSD D1 backtest 2025; PERIOD_CURRENT configurable; M1 for crosses.
why_new_for_mis: Volatility yardstick from the larger of two opposing 3-day swing distances rather than ATR/single-bar range—MIS can sense expansion magnitude from structure, direction-agnostic.
quote: Once both swing distances are calculated, only the larger value is kept. Larry Williams treats this value as the current measure of volatility because it represents the strongest price movement observed in the recent market structure, independent of direction.

mechanism: Arm only after LW short-term swing low/high (with outside/inside exclusions); then choose VOL_SIMPLE_PREVIOUS_RANGE or VOL_SWING_BASED to project breakout levels; gate execution by Trade-Day-of-Week and optional intraday start/end window before allowing the M1 cross entry.
data_needed: Three-bar swing structure; previous-bar range or dominant swing range; weekday flags; startTime/endTime; M1 closes.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: XAUUSD D1 2025; ONLY_LONG demo; TDW often Monday-only in defaults; optional TOD filter.
why_new_for_mis: Orders sensing as structure regime → volatility expansion → calendar/session regime, so MIS can require all three contexts before treating a breakout as high-quality.
quote: Entries are not triggered by volatility alone. They are triggered by structure first and volatility second.

mechanism: IsUptrendWithPullback: today's open > close[trendLookback] (default 30) AND today's open < close[pullbackLookback] (default 9); then require previous-bar-range breakout cross for entry—objective trend+pullback without visual judgment.
data_needed: Open at index; closes at index+trendLookback and index+pullbackLookback; yesterday range multipliers.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: XAUUSD D1 2025; lookbacks 30/9; all weekdays allowed in tests.
why_new_for_mis: Fixed dual-horizon price relationships as a compact trend-with-controlled-pullback regime label MIS can track continuously.
quote: If today's open is higher than the distant close, an uptrend exists. If today's open is lower than the nearest close, a pullback has occurred.

mechanism: Flag outside bar with down close: high0>high1 and low0<low1, close0<low1, and open0>close0; treat as emotional selling extreme and sense buy-side opportunity after volatility breakout confirmation.
data_needed: Current/prior bar OHLC; range breakout level; TDW filter optional.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: XAUUSD D1 2025 (pattern rare—zero trades in sample year).
why_new_for_mis: Panic/exhaustion sensor from expanding range + close through prior low—MIS can tag fear extremes even when trade frequency is low.
quote: When such a bar closes near its low, the market appears extremely bearish. Fear is visible on the chart… this pattern marks the end of panic rather than its beginning.

mechanism: Smash buy: close below lows of smashBuyLookbackBars prior bars and not an outside bar; store breakout=high and SL=low; keep setup live only for smashSetupValidityBars; invalidate if unused; optional Supertrend align and TDW; enter on level cross or bar-close beyond smash high/low.
data_needed: Lookback smash closes vs prior highs/lows; barsSinceSmash counter; Supertrend bands; weekday allow-list.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Configurable _Symbol/timeframe; Supertrend ATR period/multiplier and optional HTF; validity bars default 3.
why_new_for_mis: Reversal setup as a timed, decaying state machine—MIS can sense not only smash events but when reversal pressure has expired.
quote: Each detected setup is assigned a limited lifespan defined by a user-specified number of future bars. If the price fails to trigger an entry within this window, the setup is automatically discarded.

mechanism: Hidden smash buy: bar closes in lower portion of its range yet above prior close; confirm next bar closes above smash high; sell mirror (upper-range close below prior close, then close below smash low). Optional Supertrend on higher TF (e.g. weekly) gates direction; SL via smash structure or ATR×multiplier.
data_needed: Hidden-smash indicator buffers at index 2; confirmation bar high/low/close; Supertrend bull/bear state; ATR; TDW.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: XAUUSD D1 signals; Supertrend on weekly in exp2; 2025-01-01 to 2026-02-28.
why_new_for_mis: Close-location-within-bar as a stealth reversal sensor, layered with HTF trend context—MIS can fuse micro structure with macro regime.
quote: For a bullish Hidden Smash setup, the bar closes in the lower portion of its range while still closing above the previous bar’s close.

mechanism: Detect open below prior low (gap down) or above prior high (gap up) with gap≥minimumGapSizePoints; store prior extreme as fill level and gap-bar extreme as SL; age setup each new bar up to maxGapValidityBars; confirm only when a later completed bar closes back through the fill level.
data_needed: Open vs prior high/low in points; gapBarTime; barsSinceGap; previousHigh/Low; confirmation close.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: XAUUSD D1; min gap 500 points; maxGapValidityBars=3; multi-year tester run.
why_new_for_mis: Failed opening-gap as a stateful liquidity/emotion reversal sensor with explicit size and expiry—MIS can track gap-fill probability windows.
quote: The market opens beyond the previous bar’s range, but later reverses back into that range.

mechanism: Migrate SQLite/OLTP history to Parquet via DuckDB; Hive-partition market data; UTC-forced queries; Golden Cross sample is illustration of screening speed, not a new market sensor.
data_needed: Parquet tables; Hive partitions; DuckDB UTC session; MT5 downloader sync.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Broker MetaQuotes-Demo Forex and Indexes; daily Golden Cross example over ~1250 days.
why_new_for_mis: After full read: infrastructure and query hygiene for analysis pipelines; no standalone regime/vol/liquidity/neural sensing mechanism for MIS to adopt.
quote: This is the whole point about the OLAP-friendly data store we are building here.

mechanism: Align leader/follower closes by timestamp (ORDER BY time,row_id); compute log returns; shift leader returns by lags 1…max_lag; corr(lead_lag_i, lag_ret); mark lag significant if |corr| > 2/sqrt(N); prefer distinct non-zero lag peak over contemporaneous Lag_0 (Epps/session caveats).
data_needed: Hive Parquet OHLC for lead+candidates; timeframe; lookback days; session_start/end; sample_size N.
why_new_for_mis: Cross-asset information-diffusion lag as a multi-instrument lead/follow sensor—MIS can detect when one series systematically precedes another at low frequency.
quote: A true follower with lag will show a distinct peak in correlation at a non-zero lag.

mechanism: Shift leader close by measured lag bars; rolling OLS beta=REGR_SLOPE(laggard, lead_shifted); residual=laggard−beta×lead_shifted; z=(residual−rolling_mean)/√var; open when |z|>ZOpen (e.g. 2), flatten near ZClose—senses lagged mean-reversion dislocation.
data_needed: Aligned M1 (or chosen TF) closes for leader/laggard; lag bars; rolling window; z thresholds.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: XAUUSD leader, GDX.US laggard; PERIOD_M1; InpLagBars=5; window=60; ZOpen=2.0.
why_new_for_mis: Converts lead/lag into a residual z-score change sensor of follower dislocation vs shifted leader expectation.
quote: The residual is the value we use for generating signals, the deviation from the expected value.

mechanism: 200-day SMA of highs and lows; rho ratchet: in bull rho=max(mu_l,rho), in bear rho=min(mu_h,rho); switch to bull only if close>rho, to bear only if close<rho—path-dependent regime with memory that suppresses whipsaws.
data_needed: Daily high/low/close; 200-bar SMA buffers; persistent m_regime and m_rho state.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: NVDA,AAPL,MSFT,GOOG,AMZN,META; daily; ~5y backtests; AMZN best Sharpe in sample.
why_new_for_mis: Explicit hysteresis regime filter (not a single MA cross)—MIS gets a sticky bull/bear state that only flips after closing beyond the high/low channel.
quote: Our market regime filter requires the price to close below the low of the channel before switching into a bear regime.

mechanism: Floating axis=SMA(median,5); DynVolUnit=alpha×avg(range,5) with alpha≈0.16; ValueChart=(price−floating_axis)/DynVolUnit; bull entries when ValueChart low < −7.5; pairs with DVO percent-rank (bear) and SVAPO±1.5σ bands (bull exhaustion).
data_needed: OHLC; 5-bar median/range SMAs; VC thresholds; DVO theta+252 rank; SVAPO TEMA/volume slope hist+100-bar StdDev.
why_new_for_mis: Volatility-normalized relative price (Value Chart) keeps overbought/oversold comparable across vol regimes—core MIS volatility-adaptive location sensor.
quote: This level remains statistically relevant in high or low-volatility markets, where static overbought/oversold levels could become inaccurate.

mechanism: Pre-screen price≥$5, 14d avg volume≥1e6, 14d ATR≥$0.50; at OR end compute RelVol%=100×OR_volume/avg(prior 14 OR volumes); trade top-N if RelVol≥threshold; bias from OR candle direction; ATR-scaled stop; flat at session close.
data_needed: Session-synced OR bars (M5 etc.); 14 historical OR volumes; D1 ATR/avg volume; ET↔broker time offset/DST.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Top liquid NASDAQ stocks; OR on M5 (also M10–H1 tested); US RTH 9:30–16:00 ET.
why_new_for_mis: Liquidity/activity spike sensor at the open that selects 'stocks in play'—MIS can flag abnormal opening-range participation before directional ORB.
quote: Stocks in Play, which are stocks that show higher than normal trading activity on a specific day, mostly because of fundamental news about the company.

mechanism: Per day: if return<0 use StdDev(returns,20) else close; SignedPower(·,2); Ts_ArgMax over 5 days of that series; cross-sectional rank then demean to [−0.5,+0.5]; evaluate predictive power via daily IC vs forward returns (and cumulative IC for decay/regime break) without requiring a full backtest wrapper.
data_needed: Universe D1 OHLC/returns; 20-day return std; 5-day argmax window; cross-sectional ranks; forward returns for IC.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Market Watch semiconductor/Nasdaq universe; D1; TXN backtest example; ~498-day IC window.
why_new_for_mis: Auditable formulaic sequence sensor of downside vol asymmetry + peak timing, scored by IC—MIS can monitor alpha decay as a meta-regime on signal quality.
quote: If the daily close-to-close return is negative, we calculate the daily returns standard deviation for the last 20 days. Otherwise, we use the current closing price.
